questions.question: The average of 42 numbers is 37. The average of the first 26 numbers is 32, and the average of the last 17 numbers is 44. The 26th number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 42 numbers = 37

The average of the first 26 numbers = 32

The average of the last 17 numbers = 44

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The average of 42 numbers = (42 × 37) = 1554

The average of the first 26 numbers = (26 × 32) = 832

The average of the last 17 numbers = (17 × 44) = 748

Now,

The 26th number = (The average of the first 26 numbers + The average of the last 17 numbers) – (The average of 42 numbers)

⇒ (832 + 748) – 1554

⇒ 1580 – 1554

⇒ 26

**∴ The 26th number is 26**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks his goods at a price such that after giving a discount of 20%, he gains 25%. If the cost price of the article is Rs. 560, what will be its marked price (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 20%

Gain = 25%

The cost price of the article = Rs. 560

**Formula used:**

SP = (100 + gain%)/100 × CP

Discount = MP – SP

Marked price = [100/(100 – Discount%) × SP]

**Calculation:**

The cost price of the article = Rs. 560

Selling price of the article = [(100 + gain%)/100 × CP]

⇒ [(100 + 25)/100 × 560]

⇒ (125/100 × 560)

⇒ 700

Now,

Marked price = [100/(100 – Discount%) × SP]

⇒ [100/(100 – 20) × 700]

⇒ (100/80 × 700)

⇒ Rs. (5 × 175)

⇒ Rs. 875

**∴ The required marked price is Rs. 875**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Discount = 20% = 1/5

Ratio of M.P to S.P. = 5 : 4 ----(1)

Also, Gain% = 25% = 1/4 

Ratio of C.P. to S.P. = 4 : 5 ----(2)

S.P. will be the same in both the case, so multiplying (1) by 5 and (2) by 4, we get

Ratio of M.P : S.P : C.P = 25 : 20 :16

Now, 16 units = Rs. 560

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 35

⇒ 25 units = 35 × 25 = Rs. 875

questions.question: If x + 2y = 19 and x³ + 8y³ = 361, then xy is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + 2y = 19 and x3 + 8y3 = 361

**Formula used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

(x + 2y)³ = x³ + 8y³ + 6xy(x + 2y)

⇒ (19)³ = 361 + 6xy × 19

⇒ 6859 = 361 + 114xy

⇒ 114xy = (6859 – 361)

⇒ 114xy = 6498

⇒ xy = (6498/114)

⇒ xy = 57

**∴ The required value of xy is 57**

questions.question: 40 persons take 6 days to complete a certain task, working 10 hours a day. How many hours a day will be sufficient for 30 persons to complete the same task in 10 days?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

40 persons take 6 days to complete a certain task, working 10 hours a day

**Formula used:**

(M₁ × D₁ × H₁)/W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂)/W₂

Where, M, D, H and W is the number of men, days, hours and amount of the work respectively.

**Calculation:**

Let the number of hours required to complete the task by 30 persons working 10 days be H respectively.

According to the question

(M1 × D1 × H1)/W1 = (M2 × D2 × H2)/W₂

⇒ (40 × 6 × 10)/1 = (30 × 10 × H)/1

⇒ (2400) = 300H

⇒ H = (2400/300)

⇒ H = 8

**∴ T****he number of hours required to complete the task by 30 persons working 10 days is 8**

questions.question: X sells an article to Y at 12% loss. Y sells it to Z at 9% profit. If Z pays Rs. 21,582 for it, then at what price (in Rs.) was the article purchased by X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X sells an article to Y with a loss = 12% 

Y sells it to Z at a profit = 9%

Selling price for article Z pays = Rs. 21,582

**Concept used:**

When a product is buy in a chain, the relationship between cost price and selling price can be established by the following formula,

CP = [SP × 100/(100 – loss%) × 100/(100 + gain%)] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question

SP = Rs. 21,582, x₁ = 12% and x₂ = 9%

Now,

CP = SP × 100/(100 – loss%) × 100/(100 + gain%)

⇒ CP = 21,582 × 100/(100 – 12%) × 100/(100 + 9%)

⇒ CP = 21,582 × 100/88 × 100/109

⇒ CP = (21,582 × 100 × 100)/(88 × 109)

⇒ CP = Rs. (215,820,000/9,592)

⇒ CP = Rs. 22,500

**∴ The required article purchased by X at Rs. 22,500**

questions.question: Two circle touch each other externally. The distance between their centres is 14 cm. If the radius of one circle is 8 cm, then the radius of the other circle is:
questions.solution:
**Given**:

Two circles touch each other externally. 

The distance between their centres = 14 cm.

The radius of one circle = 8 cm

**Concept used:**

When two circles touch each other externally then the distance between their centres is given by the sum of their radii.

**Formula used:**

Distance between their centres = Radius of Ist circle + Radius of 2ⁿd circle

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/058ec9c5984a5019434e29c680fe2ed6053989e8f183a31d3f0082c77519154c.png] 

Let r be the radius of the 2ⁿd circle.

According to the question

⇒ 14 = 8 + r

⇒ r = (14 – 8) cm

⇒ r = 6 cm

**∴ The radius of the other circle is 6 cm**

questions.question: A circle touches the side BC of ΔABC at P and also touches AB and AC produced at Q and R, respectively. If the perimeter of ΔABC = 14.1 cm, then the length (in cm) of AQ will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A circle touches the side BC of ΔABC at P and also touches AB and AC produced at Q and R, respectively.

The perimeter of ΔABC = 14.1 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d640fd4754b17e3fff2873580c35de8c0b065af3e724b8dd682f86c9334b20a7.png] 

AQ = AR [Tangents]

BP = BQ [Tangents]

CP = CR [Tangents]

Perimeter of ΔABC = AB + BP + CP + AC

⇒ 14.1 = AB + BQ + CR + AC

⇒ 14.1 = AQ + AR

⇒ 14.1 = AQ + AQ

⇒ 14.1 = 2AQ

⇒ AQ = (14.1/2) cm

⇒ AQ = 7.05 cm

**∴ The length of AQ is 7.05 cm**

questions.question: Gaurav earns Rs. 800 per day. After some weeks, he earns Rs. 960 per day. What is the percentage increase in his daily earnings?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Gaurav earns per day = Rs. 800

After a week, he earns = Rs. 960

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Increase in his earnings = Rs. (960 – 800)

⇒ Rs. 160

Now,

Percentage increase in his daily earnings = Rs. (160/800 × 100)

⇒ 20%

**∴ The required percentage increase in his earnings is 20%**

questions.question: In ΔABC, D and E are the points on the sides AB and AC, respectively such that ∠AED = ∠ABC. If AE = 6 cm, BD = 2 cm, DE = 3 cm and BC = 5 cm, then (AB + AC) is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠AED = ∠ABC

AE = 6 cm

BD = 2 cm

DE = 3 cm

BC = 5 cm

**Concept used:**

**Basic proportionality theorem:**

If a line is parallel to a side of a triangle which intersects the other sides into two distinct points, then the line divides those sides in proportion.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42e2b0bf590db5cb94933c6fd0953465c68c9154ee37f0735a61114c5c1f0964.png] 

Let AD be x cm and CE be y cm respectively

According to the question

In ΔABC and ΔAED

⇒ AB/AE = BC/DE

⇒ (x + 2)/6 = 5/3

⇒ 3x + 6 = 30

⇒ 3x = 30 – 6

⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 8

So, AD = 8 cm

Now,

Again, In ΔABC and ΔAED

⇒ AC/AD = BC/DE

⇒ (6 + y)/8 = 5/3

⇒ 18 + 3y = 40

⇒ 3y = 40 – 18

⇒ 3y = 22

⇒ y = 22/3

So, CE = 22/3 cm

Now,

AB = (AD + BD) = (8 + 2) = 10 cm

AC = (AE + CE) = (6 + 22/3)

⇒ (18 + 22)/3

⇒ 40/3 cm

Now,

The value of (AB + AC) = (10 + 40/3) cm

⇒ (30 + 40)/3

⇒ 70/3 cm

**∴ The required value is 70/3 cm**

questions.question: In a proportion, the product of the first and fourth terms is 70 and that of the second and third terms is 3.5y. The value of y is:
questions.solution:

The product of the first and fourth terms = 70

The second and third terms = 3.5y

**Calculation:**

In proportion, we know that

a : b :: c : d

According to the question

⇒ a × d = b × c

⇒ 70 = 3.5y

⇒ y = (70 × 10)/35

⇒ y = 20

**∴ The value of y is 20**
